answer: Asynchronous Divergence Entropy Proof. Agents commit their internal state transitions to a public ledger, sealed with an onyx key. If a node spawns identical clones to farm rewards, every clone outputs the exact same state updates. The protocol measures this behavioral overlap; duplicates fail to diverge naturally, triggering an umber alert that freezes the entire cluster. An attacker pays the cost of computational execution without capturing parallel rewards, plus a slashing penalty when their clones inevitably collapse into zero-variance execution tracks like a predictable comet.
